template.name: GetTableComprehensiveDetails
template.description: 특정 테이블의 종합 정보 (기본 정보, 속성 목록, 관련 템플릿 개수)
template.query: query GetTableComprehensiveDetails($tableIdentifier: String!) { table: tableByIdentifier(identifier: $tableIdentifier) { id identifier description attributeCount tableNodeCount createdAt updatedAt attributes { id identifier name description attributeType { id name } } } relatedTemplates: searchTemplates(filter: { search: $tableIdentifier }) { totalCount nodes { identifier name usageCount isActive } } }
